於本年度內，本公司並未按守則條文第A.5條的    During the year, the Company has not established Nomination Committee as

事會主席吳女士將配合公司發展戰略的需求不時     Wu, as the Chairperson of the Board, will review and discuss with other Board
與董事會探討董事會的架構，人員及組成（包括     members on the structure, size and composition (including the skills, knowledge
技能、知識及經驗方面），並物色合資格擔任董     and experience) of the Board from time to time based on the requirements
事的人選，並在需要時向董事會提名有關人士。     matching up with the Company’s corporate strategy, and identify individuals
董事會認為，由董事會主席負責董事提名比成立     suitably qualified to become board members and make recommendations to the

風險管理                     RISK MANAGEMENT
有效的風險管理是本集團達致戰略目標的基本及    Effective risk management is the basic and necessary factor for achieving strategic
必要保障，為此本集團已制定《龍湖集團風險管    goals of the Group. As such, the Group has established the Risk Management
理制度》。制度中明確了本集團風險管理組織體    System of Longfor Group , which specifies the Group’s risk management
系及具體職責、風險管理整體流程、風險評估方    organizational system, detailed responsibility, overall procedures of risk
法，以及定期的風險報告機制。           management, risk assessment method and regular risk reporting mechanism.

風險管理組織體系：龍湖集團的風險管理組織體    Risk management organizational system: The risk management organizational
系是董事會領導下的三道基本防線，即公司業務    system of Longfor Group consists of three basic lines of defense under the
職能部門的管理層和員工為第一道防線；由集團    leadership of the Board, namely the management and staff of business
職能部門負責人組成的，首席執行官為組長、首    departments as the first line of defense; the risk management team consisting
席財務官為副組長的風險管理小組為第二道防     of the general manager of business departments of the Group with the CEO as
線；審核委員會和內審中心為第三道防線。董事    team leader and CFO as deputy team leader as the second line of defense; and
會是風險管理的最終責任機構，有權對集團風險    the Audit Committee and internal audit centre as the third line of defense. The
管理的政策制度及應對方案進行指引和最終決     Board shall be the ultimate accountability body of risk management, and shall
策，評估集團風險偏好，把握在戰略目標實現及    have the right to provide guidance and make final decisions on the policy, system
風險管理之間的匹配度；審核委員會和內審中心    and responding plan of risk management of the Group, conduct assessment on
由董事會委派，對公司風險管理的實施情況進行    the risk appetite of the Group and control the balance between the realization of
指導監控，並審閱年度風險管理報告；風險管理    strategic goals and risk management. The Audit Committee and internal audit
小組負責不斷完善風險管理體系，執行包括風險    centre are authorized by the Board to advise on and monitor the implementation
識別、評估、應對方案以及風險管理報告的管理    of risk management of the Group and review the annual risk management report.
流程，包括年度更新風險庫，對應對方案實施進    The risk management team is responsible for the ongoing improvement of risk
行跟蹤監控，編製並匯報風險管理報告。業務部    management system as well as the implementation of management procedures
門是風險所有者，對各自的風險領域實施管理與    including risk identification, assessment, responding plan and risk management
監控。                      report, covering the annual update of risk database, follow-up and monitoring
                         of the implementation of responding plan and the preparation and reporting of
                         the risk management report. The business departments are risk owners and shall
                         manage and monitor their respective risk exposure.

                         response and supervision and risk reporting.

     限制性股份激勵計劃                                 RESTRICTED SHARE AWARD SCHEME
     本公司已經採用限制性股份激勵計劃，計劃目的                     To provide long-term incentive for employees, assist to retain its existing
     為僱員提供長期激勵，協助本集團保留其現有僱                     employees and attract more talents, and provide human resources protection for
     員及吸引更多優秀人才，為本集團的長期戰略目                     the long-term strategic goals of the Group, the Company has adopted a restricted
     標提供人力資源保障。根據此計劃，受託人將以                     share award scheme. According to the share award scheme, trustee can purchase
     本公司提供的現金於市場上購買現有股份，並以                     shares from the market out of cash contributed by the Group. The shares are held
     信託形式代相關選定僱員持有，直至該等股份按                     in trust for the relevant selected employees until such shares are vested.
     計劃規則歸屬予相關選定僱員為止。

                   及資產組合而言，產出並非符合業                          activities and assets to qualify as a business. To be considered as

                   兩者結合能顯著有助於創造產出之
                   能力。

                   續提供產出之能力。該等修訂本亦                          and continuing to produce outputs. The amendments also introduce
                   引進額外指引，以協助釐定是否已                          additional guidance that helps to determine whether a substantive
                   獲得實質性過程。                                 process has been acquired.

                   集中度測試，允許對所收購之活動                          test that permits a simplified assessment of whether an acquired

                   產組合並非業務。該測試下之總資                          cash equivalents, deferred tax assets, and goodwill resulting from
                   產不包括現金及現金等價物、遞延                          the effects of deferred tax liabilities. The election on whether to

      12. 投資物業                                      12. INVESTMENT PROPERTIES
            本集團根據經營租賃出租各公寓及零售店                             The Group leases out various apartments and retail stores under operating
            舖，須按月支付租金。租賃的初始期限一                             leases with rentals payable monthly. The leases typically run for an initial
            般為1個月至20年。零售店舖的租賃包含                            period of 1 month to 20 years. The leases of retail stores contain variable
            按1%至28%銷售計算的浮動租賃付款及根                           lease payment that are based on 1% to 28% sales and minimum annual
            據租賃期限固定的最低年度租賃付款。                              lease payment that are fixed over the lease term.

            本集團因租賃安排未面臨外幣風險，原因                             The Group is not exposed to foreign currency risk as a result of the lease
            為所有租賃均以集團實體各自的功能貨                              arrangements, as all leases are denominated in the respective functional
            幣計值。租賃合約並無載列剩餘價值擔保                             currencies of group entities. The lease contracts do not contain residual
            及╱或承租人於租期結束時購買物業的權                             value guarantee and/or lessee’s option to purchase the property at the end
            利。                                             of lease term.

                   劃」）乃根據於二零零九年十二月                               was adopted pursuant to a resolution passed on December 23, 2009

  股東帶來最大回報。                         shareholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance.

  及保留盈利）。                           reserves and retained earnings.

  閱的一部分，本公司董事考慮資本成本及                basis. As part of this review, the directors of the Company consider the

  於二零二一年一月六日及七日，本集團透        On January 6 and 7, 2021, the Group through Chongqing Longhu
  過重慶龍湖企業拓展發行2021年第一期       Development issued the first tranche of the 2021 domestic corporate bonds
  境內公司債券人民幣30億元，分為兩個品       of RMB3 billion in two forms: five-year bond of RMB2 billion which
  種：為期五年的人民幣20億元的債券，當       Chongqing Longhu Development is entitled to adjust the coupon rate after
